part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `UnixStream::resolve_unix_socket_addr` (tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs:6183), which is used by both `UnixListener::bind` and `UnixStream::connect`: it passed the full path including the leading `\0` to `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, which expects the name *without* the prefix. The fix strips the leading `\0` via `strip_prefix` before calling `from_abstract_name`.

Verified with the existing `abstract_socket_name` test (`cargo test -p tokio --features full --test uds_stream`) — all 8 tests pass.
